NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL S. U. REGISTRY No. S. A. D. Date）
APR 16 1939

Local Anti-Comintern
Fete Called Off

Divergence in Reasons Given
For Cancellation

Lack of sufficient space to accom-
modate the large crowd was given
as the official reason, for the can-
cellation of the anti-Comintern party
which was to have taken place at
the Astor House Hotel last night
and at which Germans, Italians and
Japanese were to celebrate, the
“Tairiku Shimpo” reported yester-
day.
The Embassy spokesman question-
ed at yesterday’s press conference
said that officially he ignored the
reason for the cancellation of the
affair, but that rumours had it that
the committee in charge of pre-
parations did not have sufficient
time to arrange all details in con-
nection with the event.
According to other sources, how-
ever, the affair was cancelled when
one of the national groups declined
the invitation to attend.

FILE
R

《字林西报》
（印：上海公共租界工部局特别科登记处 编号 S. A. D. 日期）
1939年4月16日

本地反共产国际
庆典取消

关于取消原因的说法存在分歧

据《大陆新报》昨日报道，官方给出的取消原定昨晚在礼查饭店举行的反共产国际聚会的理由是“缺乏足够空间容纳大量人群”，在该聚会上，德国人、意大利人和日本人本将共同庆祝。

在昨日的新闻发布会上被问及此事的使馆发言人表示，他在官方层面上不理会活动取消的原因，但有传闻称，负责筹备工作的委员会没有足够的时间安排与该活动有关的所有细节。

然而，据其他消息来源称，该活动是在其中一个国家群体拒绝出席邀请后取消的。

归档
R

Anti-Comintern
Party At Astor
House Postponed

accommodate the large crowd"
which assertedly planned to
attend the Japan-Germany-Italy

which was to be held at the

the Shanghai anti-Comintern
Cultural Society, the daily
stated.

REPORT
（框内文字：SHANGHAI Municipal Police / S. E. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D 39 / Date April 14 1939.）

Subject Ball to be held in the Astor House on April 15 by the
Anti-Comintern Cultural Association.
Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross.

In regard to the ball scheduled to take place
in the Astor House at 9 p.m. April 15 under the auspices of
the Anti-Comintern Cultural Association, I have to state that
this function is being sponsored by the "Political and
Economical Society", an organization formed by local Japanese
residents. Members of this society include military and
naval officers, Consular officials and businessmen who exchange
from time to time their knowledge and views on matters relating
to local politics and economics.

With a view to promoting closer friendship among
local Japanese, German and Italian officials and civilians,
the "Political and Economical Society" has decided to hold a
ball under the name of the "Anti-Comintern Cultural Association"
and for this purpose several hundred invitations have been
issued. During the course of the function, entertainment
in the form of a display of Japanese dancing and military
arts will be given.

The executives of the Anti-Comintern Cultural
Association include Mr. G. Hashimoto, ratepayers' representative
of the Japanese Residents Corporation, and Mr. T. Hasegawa of
the local office of the South Manchurian Railway Company.

主题：反共产国际文化协会于4月15日在礼查饭店举行的舞会。
制作及转呈人：C.D.I. Ross。

关于反共产国际文化协会主持下定于4月15日晚9时在礼查饭店举行的舞会，本人须陈述如下：该活动由“政治经济学会”赞助，这是一个由当地日本居民组成的组织。该学会成员包括军方和海军军官、领事官员以及商人，他们不时交流有关当地政治和经济事务的知识和观点。

为了促进当地日本、德国和意大利官员及平民之间更紧密的友谊，“政治经济学会”决定以“反共产国际文化协会”的名义举行一次舞会，为此已发出数百份邀请函。在活动过程中，将提供日本舞蹈和武术表演作为娱乐项目。

反共产国际文化协会的执行委员包括日本居留民团纳税人代表 G. Hashimoto（音译）先生，以及南满洲铁道株式会社当地办事处的 T. Hasegawa（音译）先生。

CHINA PRESS.
APR 1 2 1939

Culture A La Axis
Hongkew To Have Anti-Red
Fete On 'Eve Of World War'

"Prominent" German, Italian,
and Japanese residents of Shang-
hai will participate in a tripartite
anti-Comintern function scheduled
to be held under the auspices of
the "anti-Comintern Cultural
Society of Shanghai" at 9 o'clock
next Saturday evening, the Japan-
ese press reported yesterday.

Scheduled to last until early
Sunday morning, the party will be
featured by a dance contest on the
ground floor of the Astor House
Hotel, where the gathering is being
held, the dailies stated. More than
800 persons are expected to attend,
according to the Japanese press.

Describing the coming party, the
Shanghai Mainichi termed it as
"a festival of the holy anti-
Comintern on the eve of the coming
World War."
Concluding the announcement,
the Mainichi drew attention to the
fact that those who wished to
attend the forthcoming party
could do so in informal dress. "The
participants need not necessarily
wear morning coats. Any black suit
will do perfectly," the Japanese
journal said.
page_data.zh:
《大美晚报》
1939年4月12日

轴心国式文化
虹口将在“世界大战前夕”举行反赤庆典

据日本媒体昨日报道，上海“显赫”的德国、意大利和日本居民将参加由“上海反共产国际文化社”主持的三方反共产国际活动，该活动定于下周六晚9时举行。

各日报称，聚会预计将持续至周日清晨，主要活动是在举行聚会的礼查饭店一楼进行舞蹈比赛。据日本媒体报道，预计将有800多人出席。

《上海每日新闻》在描述即将到来的聚会时，称其为“即将到来的世界大战前夕的神圣反共产国际节日”。
《每日新闻》在公告结尾提请注意，希望参加即将举行的聚会的人可以穿着非正式服装。“参与者不一定非要穿晨礼服。任何黑色西装都完全合适，”这家日本报刊说道。

G. 150 - 138

April 11. 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

SHANGHAI ANTI COMINTERN CULTURE ASSOCIATION
TO GIVE BALL

It is reported that under the
auspices of the Shanghai Anti-Comintern Culture
Association a Japan-Germany-Italy Anti-Comintern ball
will be held at 9 p.m. April 14 at the Astor house
to promote friendship among the residents of Shanghai.
During the ball an exhibition of judo, fencing and
Japanese classical dances will be held.
About 900 persons are reported
to have already applied for admittance. The important
members of the German Nazi Party and the Italian
Fascist Party in the Far East will attend. Japanese
residents will be welcomed. It is advised that
persons wishing to attend the party should apply to
Mr. Nakazawa at the Japanese Club.

1939年4月11日。

《大陆新报》

上海反共产国际文化协会
将举办舞会

据报道，在上海反共产国际文化协会的主持下，为促进上海居民之间的友谊，将于4月14日晚9时在礼查饭店举行日德意反共产国际舞会。
舞会期间将举行柔道、击剑和日本古典舞蹈表演。
据报道，已有约900人申请入场。远东地区德国纳粹党和意大利法西斯党的重要成员将出席。欢迎日本居民参加。建议希望参加聚会的人向日本俱乐部的 Nakazawa（音译）先生申请。
